geographic_assessment.approximation_method: Manual tracing of Figure1 red dashed shelf model contour using printed WGS84 grid and coastline landmarks, clipped by shared NaturalEarth50m land for a consistent marine-area comparison. LME target is original digital SAU boundary; compatible coordinates and geodesic areas, not raw screenshot pixels. The trace is illustrative, not author-supplied and not a fitted bathymetric contour.
geographic_assessment.landmarks_and_bounds: Shelf west boundary near12W; north approximately52.5N off Ireland; western English Channel to about2W; southern shelf approximately48N. The caption defines<200m in ICES7.e/f/g/h/j.2. Coastline indentation and bathymetry are coarsely traced.
geographic_assessment.uncertainty: Approximate ranges reflect visual tracing/coastline/shelf-boundary ambiguity, not statistical confidence intervals. Pixel-derived coarse coordinate error is about0.1–0.3degrees near shelves; detailed ICES<200m clipping has not been recovered.
geographic_assessment.geometry_caveat: Use explicitly labeled visual trace if adopted into article display; target LME boundary remains unchanged. Exact author polygon remains unavailable.
